findings.problem: Without a hint, Schön, dich kennenzulernen! or Freut mich, dich kennenzulernen! are also common, correct answers to Nice to meet you!
findings.fix: hint: The short two-word reply, not schön, dich kennenzulernen

back.target: Pleased to meet you! (literally: pleases me)
back.example: Pleased to meet you! I'm from Hamburg.

note: Freut mich! works for both du and Sie, so the hint doesn't need to say informal or formal.
